FUJITSU/MBM27128.note: Figure 3, the Quick Pro flow chart on page 4-20, specifies TPW = 1 ms +/- 50 us with VCC = 6V +/- 0.25V, VPP = 21V +/- 0.5V and an X = 20 pulse ceiling. Page 4-19's conventional procedure specifies a 50 ms pulse and is the wrong reading here: the firmware consumes this field as the initial pulse width of a verify-per-pulse loop capped at 25 pulses with overprogram_factor = 0 on protocols 0x07 and 0x08, which is the fast Quick Pro algorithm's shape and not the conventional single-shot one. Note also that the corrected value still yields an incomplete Quick Pro, because the firmware never emits the datasheet's tOPW over-program pulse.
